plan.title: Single-stage All Vendors Save closes dialog

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Provide the required event title before configuring the event.
Choose the available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Confirm the Participants panel is open.
Confirm the All Vendors window opened.
Save the empty All Vendors selection.
Verify that the All Vendors window closes after saving.
Verify that the screen returns to the Participants panel.
Verify that no error message is shown.
